FN-YAZ062-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 93
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Jay Hovey
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 93 as introduced appropriates $389,327 from the Education Trust Fund to the
Southern Preparatory Academy, formerly Lyman Ward Military Academy, for the fiscal year
ending September 30, 2024.
Page 1
